facts.topic: glide and ordinary mob travel coexist
facts.contract: The matched travel-sensing view includes MobTravelComponent. Its concrete callback adds GlidingTravelFlagComponent for the gliding actor flag, while its typed modifier lists travel tags but not MobTravelComponent. This path retains mob travel for the subsequent glide and levitation systems.

facts.contract: The glide view includes rotation, MobEffects, FallDistance, StateVector, ActorMovementTickNeeded and GlidingTravel. The later levitation view includes MobEffects, StateVector and MobTravel and excludes PlayerFlyingTravel. It does not exclude GlidingTravel. The inspected tryStartGliding route has no MobEffects/levitation check.

facts.contract: Normal-category insertion order puts glide movement and actor movement before levitation. Glide already applies its own drag in its velocity callback; levitation subsequently uses the resolved vertical velocity, multiplies by0.8f, adds float(amplifier+1)*0.01f and adds LevitateTravelFlagComponent. This supports applying levitation after glide collision without another ordinary gravity or drag step.

implementation.change: Gliding now applies active positive-level levitation to resolved vertical velocity after collision; ordinary glide behavior and its existing drag remain unchanged.
